keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for the last days of 1989: the Socialist Republic page gives 'Fall of Ceausescu: 22 December 1989' and 'Name changed to "Romania": 28 December 1989'; Cliopatria starts its Romania row in 1990 with the same outline.

238,172 km2 against the infobox 238,397 km2 (ratio 0.999). The 1990 shape has the outline of the Socialist Republic's 1987-1989 shape; no frontier changed with the regime. The 'Bulgaria' and 'Ukraine' in the shape's country list are probably outline slivers.

238,152 km2 (20 km2 less than 1990, outline detail); the Romania page records no frontier change from 1992 to 2024 (it is silent on the Snake Island and Black Sea delimitation and on the Moldovan frontier).

ledger.note: 1989-12: Romania, no longer socialist, takes its name after the fall of Ceausescu. The page infobox gives 'Fall of Ceausescu: 22 December 1989' and 'Name changed to "Romania": 28 December 1989'; the Romania page says the uprising ended in 'the execution of Ceausescu and his wife Elena on 25 December 1989'. The current constitution is dated 8 December 1991.

certainty.note: The frontiers are those of the Socialist Republic and earlier treaties; the pages read give no treaty or change after 1989 (the Romania page is silent on Ukraine, Moldova and the Black Sea delimitation).

notes: Wikidata Q203493 is shared with kingdom-of-romania (Cliopatria 1919..1947, eu-21). The two rows are the same country under different regimes: the Kingdom ends in 1947, the Socialist Republic (socialist-republic-of-romania, 1948..1989, another part) intervenes, and this row starts with the 1989 renaming. They are kept as separate dossiers, following the Albania precedent of the same group, with the colour family balkans so the orchestrator can give them one colour. The start is 28 December 1989 (a page date); Cliopatria's row starts in 1990 and the 1989 keyframe fills the gap. Not settled: the pages read are silent on the Ukraine treaty, Snake Island and the ICJ delimitation of the Black Sea (2009), on the Moldovan frontier and on the Serbian frontier, so no ledger event records them; page budget 2 of 2 used.
